C0587.title: Danfeng County Investigates Hotel for False Price Comparison Fraud
C0587.summary: In January 2026, the Market Supervision Administration of Danfeng County, Shangluo City, Shaanxi Province, investigated a hotel that fabricated a reference price on a short-video platform to mislead consumers. The hotel advertised a false original price of 698 yuan for its rooms, a price at which no transaction had ever occurred, constituting price fraud.
